answer: One workable design: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because nadir only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, pulse is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any anchor approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
